prompt: Redraw the man in the reference image as a nineteenth-century steel engraving, the kind printed as a frontispiece portrait in a scientific journal. Keep his likeness, the three-quarter pose, his short greying hair, broad grey moustache with drooping ends, bare eyes without spectacles, pale linen work shirt with turned-down collar, and the framing (head and shoulders, same crop). Black ink lines only on cream paper: every tone is built from fine parallel hatching and cross-hatching that follows the form of the face, lines swelling in the shadows, fine stipple on the lit skin, clean contour lines, the shadows in the pale work shirt a dense cross-hatch. The figure fades into bare paper toward the bottom and the edges as an engraved vignette; the background is bare cream paper with a little horizontal ruling behind the head. No grey wash, no colour, no photographic shading, no text, no border, no signature.
tool_model: OpenAI built-in image generation (gpt-image; exact version not exposed)

tone_adjustment.method: Apply an ink-only RGB levels curve to the raw RGB image before resizing. Derive luma Y with Pillow's RGB-to-L conversion. Blend each source pixel toward (0.82Y + 5, 0.82Y - 1, 0.82Y - 9), rounded and clamped. The blend weight is smoothstep of clamp((218 - Y) / 113, 0, 1). The full adjustment applies at Y <= 105 and paper highlights at Y >= 218 retain their original RGB values.
